_comment: Real cron job, verified syntax against docs/openclaw-automation-concepts-2026-09-13.md. Deliver-on-failure only - a healthy gateway should never generate a notification.
setup_commands: openclaw approvals allowlist add "openclaw gateway status*"

openclaw automations add --cron "*/15 * * * *" --message "Run the gateway health check per your AGENTS.md. Stay silent if healthy." --agent __AGENT_ID__ --session isolated --announce --channel <bret's-reachable-channel> --to <bret's-id>
note: The --announce/--channel/--to placeholders need Bret's actual reachable channel (phone/companion app) filled in per docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/delivery - not guessed here.
